# gyro_container_schedule (Resource)

Scheduled job of a Gyro Containers (ECS) environment: a service command (run as a one-off job with the image of the running version, its variables and secrets) or an HTTP call, on a cron expression (time zone aware), every N minutes or once. A run never starts while the previous run of the same schedule is still going; failed runs can be retried (0-3). Notifications: schedule_failed / schedule_missed (gyro_container_notifications). Shortest interval 1 minute (Serverless 5). Free on node plans; on Serverless each run is billed like a task.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every night at 03:00 Istanbul time: run a command with the image, variables and secrets of the "api" service.
resource "gyro_container_schedule" "report" {
  environment_id = 123
  name           = "nightly-report"
  cron           = "0 3 * * *"
  timezone       = "Europe/Istanbul"
  service        = "api"
  command        = ["npm", "run", "report"]
  retries        = 2
}

# Every 15 minutes: call an endpoint of your application (headers are kept secret by the API).
resource "gyro_container_schedule" "queue" {
  environment_id = 123
  name           = "queue-tick"
  rate_minutes   = 15
  url            = "https://api.example.com/cron"
  method         = "POST"
  headers        = { Authorization = "Bearer ${var.cron_token}" }
}

variable "cron_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (Number) Container environment (service) id.
- `name` (String) 2-40 characters: lowercase letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter.

### Optional

- `at` (String) Run once at this time: RFC 3339, or local date-time (2026-12-01T03:00) in `timezone`. Must be in the future when set.
- `body` (String, Sensitive) HTTP body (at most 64 KB, not for GET / HEAD). Never read back.
- `command` (List of String) Command and arguments (replaces the image ENTRYPOINT; no shell unless you write ["sh","-c","..."]). Omit = the image's own command.
- `cpu_m` (Number) vCPU in millicores for a run (default: the service's).
- `cron` (String) Cron expression (5 fields: minute hour day month weekday, e.g. "0 3 * * *"; @daily, @hourly). One of cron, rate_minutes, at.
- `description` (String)
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) HTTP headers (at most 20). Kept secret by the API (never read back): Terraform keeps the configured values.
- `http_timeout_seconds` (Number) Time limit of the HTTP call (1-120, default 30).
- `memory_mi` (Number) Memory in MiB for a run (default: the service's).
- `method` (String) HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD; default GET).
- `paused` (Boolean) Paused schedules do not run.
- `rate_minutes` (Number) Run every N minutes (1-10080; Serverless at least 5).
- `retries` (Number) Retries after a failed run (0-3; 30 s × attempt apart).
- `service` (String) Service whose image, variables and secrets the command uses (service target).
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Time limit of a run (10-21600, default 1800; service target).
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone (default Europe/Istanbul).
- `url` (String) URL to call (http:// or https://; HTTP target). Private / platform addresses are refused; redirects are not followed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Schedule id.
- `next_run` (String) Next run (UTC, RFC 3339); empty when paused / completed.
- `state` (String) active, paused or completed (a one-time schedule that ran).
- `target` (String) service or http.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <environment id>/<schedule name or id>; HTTP header values cannot be read back (set them again in the configuration).
terraform import gyro_container_schedule.report 123/nightly-report
```
